newsitem.title: USA: Holly acquires firms for three mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Holly acquires firms for three mln shrs.

text.p: Holly Holdings Inc said Monday it acquired two publishing companies for an aggregate of three million of its common shares.
Holly said it had acquired 100 percent of Nightlife Printing & Promotion Inc and American Publishers Company Inc.
Nightlife sells printing materials and other related products and services for the entertainment and dining industry in New York.
American is a wholesaler of education products to schools, libraries, teachers and consumers throughout the country.
